title: Yummy Gooey Egyptian Date Tagine
description: A sweet and savory Egyptian dish featuring dates and palm sugar, perfect for a date night.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender, combine dates, palm sugar, nam tan pip, almond oil, ginger, and cinnamon, and blend until smooth.
Transfer the mixture to a saucepan and bring to a boil over medium heat.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
In a small bowl, mix sodium alginate with water to create a spherification bath.
Using a spoon, drop small amounts of the date mixture into the spherification bath.
Let the mixture sit in the bath for 5 minutes to allow the spheres to form.
Remove the spheres from the bath with a slotted spoon and place them on a wooden board.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with additional cinnamon and ginger if desired.
